subject: Mathematics
title: Trigonometric Functions and Equations
summary: Angles degrees ya radian mein naape jaate hain (π rad = 180°). Chhe trigonometric functions unit circle par define hote hain; unke signs ASTC follow karte hain (quadrants I–IV mein All, Sin, Tan, Cos positive). sin, cos ka period 2π, tan ka π.
Identities — compound angle, double angle aur multiple/sub-multiple angle, sum-to-product aur product-to-sum — kisi bhi expression ko simplify karne deti hain.
Trigonometric equation ke general solution: sin θ = sin α ⇒ θ = nπ + (−1)ⁿα; cos θ = cos α ⇒ θ = 2nπ ± α; tan θ = tan α ⇒ θ = nπ + α.
a sin θ + b cos θ ki range [−√(a² + b²), √(a² + b²)] hai — maximum/minimum sawalon ka JEE favourite.

formulas.name: Basic identities
formulas.formula: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1;  1 + tan²θ = sec²θ;  1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ
formulas.when: Ek function se doosre mein badalna.

formulas.name: Compound angles
formulas.formula: sin(A ± B) = sin A cos B ± cos A sin B;  cos(A ± B) = cos A cos B ∓ sin A sin B;  tan(A ± B) = (tan A ± tan B)/(1 ∓ tan A tan B)

formulas.name: Useful products
formulas.formula: sin(A + B) sin(A − B) = sin²A − sin²B;  cos(A + B) cos(A − B) = cos²A − sin²B

formulas.name: Double angle
formulas.formula: sin 2θ = 2 sin θ cos θ = 2 tan θ/(1 + tan²θ);  cos 2θ = cos²θ − sin²θ = 1 − 2sin²θ = 2cos²θ − 1 = (1 − tan²θ)/(1 + tan²θ);  tan 2θ = 2 tan θ/(1 − tan²θ)

formulas.name: Triple angle
formulas.formula: sin 3θ = 3 sin θ − 4 sin³θ;  cos 3θ = 4cos³θ − 3 cos θ;  tan 3θ = (3 tan θ − tan³θ)/(1 − 3tan²θ)

formulas.name: Sum to product
formulas.formula: sin C + sin D = 2 sin((C + D)/2) cos((C − D)/2);  cos C + cos D = 2 cos((C + D)/2) cos((C − D)/2);  cos C − cos D = −2 sin((C + D)/2) sin((C − D)/2)

formulas.name: Product of three
formulas.formula: sin θ sin(60° − θ) sin(60° + θ) = ¼ sin 3θ;  cos θ cos(60° − θ) cos(60° + θ) = ¼ cos 3θ;  tan θ tan(60° − θ) tan(60° + θ) = tan 3θ

formulas.name: Range of a sin θ + b cos θ
formulas.formula: −√(a² + b²) ≤ a sin θ + b cos θ ≤ √(a² + b²)

formulas.name: General solutions
formulas.formula: sin θ = 0 ⇒ θ = nπ;  cos θ = 0 ⇒ θ = (2n + 1)π/2;  sin θ = sin α ⇒ θ = nπ + (−1)ⁿα;  cos θ = cos α ⇒ θ = 2nπ ± α;  tan θ = tan α ⇒ θ = nπ + α;  sin²θ = sin²α ⇒ θ = nπ ± α
formulas.mistake: Dono taraf square karne se extra roots aa sakte hain — hamesha check karo.

formulas.name: Sine and cosine rules
formulas.formula: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C = 2R;  cos A = (b² + c² − a²)/(2bc)

formulas.name: Conditional identities (A + B + C = π)
formulas.formula: tan A + tan B + tan C = tan A tan B tan C;  sin 2A + sin 2B + sin 2C = 4 sin A sin B sin C

examples.title: Cosines ka product
examples.solution: cos θ cos(60° − θ) cos(60° + θ) = ¼ cos 3θ, θ = 20° lekar: ¼ cos 60° = 1/8 = 0.125.

examples.title: Tangents ka product
examples.solution: tan θ tan(60° − θ) tan(60° + θ) = tan 3θ ⇒ tan 60° = √3 ≈ 1.732.

examples.title: Maximum value
examples.problem: 3 sin x + 4 cos x ki maximum value nikalo.

examples.title: Sines ka product
examples.solution: sin θ sin(60° − θ) sin(60° + θ) = ¼ sin 3θ, θ = 10° lekar: ¼ sin 30° = 0.125.

examples.title: General solution
examples.solution: 2(1 − sin²x) + 3 sin x = 0 ⇒ 2sin²x − 3 sin x − 2 = 0 ⇒ (2 sin x + 1)(sin x − 2) = 0. sin x = 2 sambhav nahi, isliye sin x = −1/2 = sin(−π/6) ⇒ x = nπ + (−1)ⁿ(−π/6), n ∈ ℤ.

topics.title: Radian measure
topics.explain: Ek radian wo angle hai jo radius ke barabar arc centre par banata hai. Arc length l = rθ (θ radians mein). 1 radian ≈ 57°16′.

topics.title: Signs and allied angles
topics.explain: Angles (90° ± θ), (270° ± θ) mein sin ↔ cos, tan ↔ cot badalte hain; (180° ± θ), (360° ± θ) mein function wahi rehta hai. Sign original angle ke quadrant se lo (ASTC).

topics.title: Graphs and periods
topics.explain: sin x aur cos x ka period 2π aur range [−1, 1]; tan x ka period π aur range ℝ (π/2 ke odd multiples par undefined). sinⁿx aur cosⁿx ka period even n ke liye π aur odd n ke liye 2π.

topics.title: Strategy for equations
topics.explain: Identities se ek hi function mein laao, factorise karo, phir general-solution formulas lagao. a cos x + b sin x = c ke liye √(a² + b²) se divide karo; solution tabhi hai jab |c| ≤ √(a² + b²).

topics.title: Sum of sines/cosines in AP
topics.explain: sin α + sin(α + β) + … n terms = sin(nβ/2)/sin(β/2) × sin(α + (n − 1)β/2); cosines ke liye bhi aisa hi formula. cos(2π/7) + cos(4π/7) + cos(6π/7) = −1/2 ke liye kaam aata hai.

topics.title: Maximum/minimum tricks
topics.explain: a sin²x + b cos²x ki range a aur b ke beech. sin x cos x jaise expressions ke liye sin 2x/2 use karo. tan²x + cot²x ≥ 2 jaise sums ke liye AM ≥ GM.
